info.title: Bus Pool System API
info.description:
All responses use `{ success, message, data }`; lists may add `pagination: { page, limit, total, totalPages }`; errors use `{ success: false, message }`.

Authentication: `POST /api/auth/login` returns an access token (send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`); the refresh token is an HTTP-only cookie used by `POST /api/auth/refresh`. Admin routes need the Admin role, driver routes the Driver role.

post.summary: Login (admin or driver). Returns an access token; sets the HTTP-only refresh cookie
Get a new access token using the refresh cookie (the refresh token rotates)
